import json, base64, subprocess, urllib.request

token = \"$TOKEN\"

# Get public key
req = urllib.request.Request(
    \"https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/secrets/public-key\",
    headers={
        \"Authorization\": f\"token {token}\",
        \"Accept\": \"application/vnd.github.v3+json\"
    }
)
resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
pk_data = json.loads(resp.read())
key_id = pk_data[\"key_id\"]
public_key = pk_data[\"key\"]
print(f\"Public key retrieved: key_id={key_id}\")

# Encrypt the secret value using NaCl (libsodium)
# We need to use pynacl or tweetnacl

    pk = public.PublicKey(public_key.encode(), encoding.Base64Encoder())
    sealed_box = public.SealedBox(pk)
    secret_value = open(\"/tmp/gh_token.txt\").read().strip()

    encrypted_b64 = base64.b64encode(encrypted).decode()
    print(f\"Encrypted secret length: {len(encrypted_b64)} chars\")

        \"encrypted_value\": encrypted_b64,
        \"key_id\": key_id

        method=\"PUT\",
        headers={
            \"Authorization\": f\"token {token}\",
            \"Accept\": \"application/vnd.github.v3+json\",
            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"
        }
    )
    resp2 = urllib.request.urlopen(req2)
    print(f\"PUT /actions/secrets/GITHUB_TOKEN → HTTP {resp2.status}\")
    
    # Also store as GH_PAT for workflows that use that name
    req3 = urllib.request.Request(
        \"https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/secrets/GH_PAT\",
        data=payload.encode(),
        method=\"PUT\",
        headers={
            \"Authorization\": f\"token {token}\",
            \"Accept\": \"application/vnd.github.v3+json\",
            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"
        }
    )
    resp3 = urllib.request.urlopen(req3)
    print(f\"PUT /actions/secrets/GH_PAT → HTTP {resp3.status}\")
    
    print(\"BOTH SECRETS STORED SUCCESSFULLY\")
    
except ImportError:
    print(\"pynacl not installed, trying pip install...\")
    subprocess.run([\"pip\", \"install\", \"pynacl\", \"--quiet\"], check=True)
    from nacl import encoding, public
    pk = public.PublicKey(public_key.encode(), encoding.Base64Encoder())
    sealed_box = public.SealedBox(pk)
    secret_value = open(\"/tmp/gh_token.txt\").read().strip()
    encrypted = sealed_box.encrypt(secret_value.encode())
    encrypted_b64 = base64.b64encode(encrypted).decode()
    print(f\"Encrypted secret length: {len(encrypted_b64)} chars\")
    
    payload = json.dumps({
        \"encrypted_value\": encrypted_b64,
        \"key_id\": key_id
    })
    
    req2 = urllib.request.Request(
        \"https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/secrets/GITHUB_TOKEN\",
        data=payload.encode(),
        method=\"PUT\",
        headers={
            \"Authorization\": f\"token {token}\",
            \"Accept\": \"application/vnd.github.v3+json\",
            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"
        }
    )
    resp2 = urllib.request.urlopen(req2)
    print(f\"PUT /actions/secrets/GITHUB_TOKEN → HTTP {resp2.status}\")
    
    req3 = urllib.request.Request(
        \"https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/secrets/GH_PAT\",
        data=payload.encode(),
        method=\"PUT\",
        headers={
            \"Authorization\": f\"token {token}\",
            \"Accept\": \"application/vnd.github.v3+json\",
            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"
        }
    )
    resp3 = urllib.request.urlopen(req3)
    print(f\"PUT /actions/secrets/GH_PAT → HTTP {resp3.status}\")
    
    print(\"BOTH SECRETS STORED SUCCESSFULLY\")
" 2>&1

echo ""
echo "=== 3. VERIFY SECRETS EXIST ==="
curl -sS --max-time 10 \
  -H "Authorization: token $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/secrets" 2>&1 | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(\"Repository secrets on ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform:\")
for s in d.get(\"secrets\",[]):
    print(f\"  {s[\"name\"]:30s} | created: {s.get(\"created_at\",\"?\")} | updated: {s.get(\"updated_at\",\"?\")}\")
print(f\"\")
print(f\"Total secrets: {d.get(\"total_count\",0)}\")
" 2>&1

echo ""
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
'

And then `GH_PAT` also failed because it was using the same encrypted payload (which was encrypted for the same key, so that should work) - but wait, the error was on GITHUB_TOKEN, and then it fell through to the except block before trying GH_PAT.

Let me retry, storing as `GH_PAT` only (not `GITHUB_TOKEN` which is reserved).
